extraction.Name: Jack Laverne Bonser
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded March 1, 1918, by R. E. Wang
extraction.Buyer: Bonser and wife mortgaged the land on June 7, 1918, to Whittemore Lewis Investment Company for $800; on the same day, they conveyed the land by deed to the Whittemore & Lewis Investment Company; Jack Laverne Bonser mortgaged the land to the Valentine State Bank for $370 subject to the $800 mortgage
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612666 issued December 29, 1917; South half of South East quarter section 12 and East half of Northeast quarter, section 13, township 38, north of range 30; receipt for patent signed by allottee February 1, 1918; $800 mortgage released May 15, 1918; Valentine State Bank mortgage of $1600 dated February 26, 1918
